cases.name: plain
cases.when: removable is false or absent -- the common case, a <span> with no interactive affordance
cases.reason: Without `removable` an ArenaTag is a label: a <span> carrying text and a tone, with nothing to press. No interactive pattern applies, and binding one with an exception would tell a reader the pattern always holds.

cases.name: removable
cases.when: removable is true -- a real <button> renders inside the tag
